witnesses.name: Besançon 1485
witnesses.scope: Forty original images privately inspected; zero public image payloads. The service enumerates 606 descriptions. Added engraving frame 400 is not attributed to the 1485 printed contents. Pater begins at frame 403 and continues through the following rites at 404–405.

witnesses.name: Huesca 1488
witnesses.scope: Original book unacquired. Lambert 1910, retained through its 1970 photographic reprint, describes the 1 June 1488 witness. Reused sheets, defective tail and possible local saint supplement remain attributed to this scholarly report; no full original text or supplement reconstruction.

witnesses.name: Tournai 1498
witnesses.scope: All 580 offered images acquired. Colophon gives Paris, Johannes Higman, expenses Wilhelm Houtmart, 20 October 1498 as printing/completion, not adoption. Strict Canon extent is located at PP 307–310; inspected boundaries are PP 307/310, with continuing rites at 311/312. No claim that interior PP 308/309 were read.

witnesses.name: Liège 1499
witnesses.scope: Forty selected images from 563 canvases acquired. The copy catalogue reports first leaf a1 missing; absent contents are not independently identified. Colophon gives Paris, sumptibus Johannis Higmani, 24 November 1499; expense responsibility does not identify a printing shop. Copy text loss and incomplete acquisition remain explicit.

witnesses.name: Tarazona 1500
witnesses.scope: Offered 658-page PDF acquired; selected original loci inspected. Colophon gives Pamplona, Brocar, 13 February 1500 and episcopal/chapter mandate. Copy defects, selected-page limits, uninspected calendar/Canon interiors and lack of observed general adoption remain explicit.

witnesses.name: Toul 1750
witnesses.scope: All 920 offered web views acquired. Imprint 1750 and 17 September 1750 letter are distinct date roles in one printing state. Mandate preserves named institutions and the qualified-priest clause. Ordinary views 304–310 and strict Canon 387–394 are located ranges verified at boundary views 304/310 and 387/394, with adjacent 311/395 context; no full-interior reading or observed-use date.

witnesses.name: Beauvais 1756
witnesses.scope: All 830 offered web images acquired. The 19 April 1756 mandate names diocesan churches, chapters, colleges, monasteries and orders, and priests bound by law or custom to celebrate or recite the Beauvais Office. It does not prove uniform uptake. Chant is directly inspected at image 292 left column and 313; image 292 right-column Advent text is unnotated.

western_originals.limits: No source admission from catalogue/title alone, inferred implementation, substantive recension, historical parent or native text. No Amiens stage is added. Complete web acquisition is not physical-copy completeness.

other_bounded_source_results: Lungro: distinct Roma 1967 Greek–Albanian setting acquired as 92 two-up spreads. Selected original title, generic undated approval and 15 December 1967 colophon checks do not locate the dated 1968 decree, resolve reported setting identities, identify receiving copies or identify the Greek exemplar.
Ravenna: attributed lectionary strips, Salzburg Gospel fragments and a modern Proper announcement remain distinct witnesses with distinct local-use limits.
Amiet: existing acquired 28-page extract and ten follow-up leads are identified without a new stage promotion.

Hungarian, Roman-component, Greek, Albanian, Macedonian and Amiens research retains its source-owned contrary evidence and unresolved original/receiving-book boundaries; catalogue findings do not close acquisition or whole-book gaps.
